transcript: How did I trick this guy into giving me 5 lakh rupees with 0 experience? Aye Nimmoun, kya phook ke aaya hai bey? Finance with Sharan was my first client in my agency. I followed 3 steps to close him. Number one: Bribe. Sharan once tagged his videographer in one of his stories. I DM'ed that videographer and asked him to setup my meeting with Sharan. He said no. So I bribed him. I told him agar Sharan mera client banta hai, I will give you 50% of my fees of the first month. That worked. Meeting setup ho gayi. Number two: Lie. In the first meeting, Sharan asked me what do you do? Now, I was just a writer at my current job. So I lied. I said main content strategy karta hu, production karta hu, editing karta hu, sab karta hu. Again, it worked. Sometimes lying is better taaki sabka bhala ho sake. Step 3: Audacity. When Sharan asked me for my prices, I pulled out the biggest number out of my ass that I could think of. 5000 rupees for 1 reel script and additional 50,000 rupees for content strategy. Total ja raha tha around 1 lakh per month. Now, if I had quoted less, usko samajh jaata that I do not have the skills that I previously lied about. So again, it worked and he became my first and the biggest client at that time. Now, if you also want such high ticket clients, comment SCAM and I will send you a full video on how to get clients.
caption: Comment “Scam” if you want Rich Clients
